response.sql: WITH eligible_players AS (SELECT player_id FROM batting_postseason GROUP BY player_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN league_id = 'NL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN round = 'WS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0), totals AS (SELECT e.player_id, SUM(b.triple) AS total_triples FROM eligible_players e JOIN batting_postseason b ON b.player_id = e.player_id GROUP BY e.player_id) SELECT player_id, total_triples FROM totals ORDER BY CASE WHEN total_triples IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, total_triples DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A player qualifies based on any postseason batting record with league_id = 'NL' and any postseason batting record with round = 'WS'; the records may differ, and triples are summed across all postseason batting records for that player.
